name: Incident Post-Mortem / Root Cause Analysis
description: Document system outages, operational failures, security incidents, or service disruptions with a structured timeline, root cause, and corrective actions.

sections.title: Incident Summary
sections.instruction: Provide a concise summary of the incident: what happened, when it was detected, what systems or services were affected, and the overall business impact.

sections.title: Incident Details
sections.instruction: Capture the key metadata of the incident including severity level, affected systems, duration, number of users or members impacted, and detection method.

sections.title: Participants
sections.instruction: List the individuals involved in the post-mortem discussion, including their roles (incident commander, responders, reviewers, etc.).

sections.title: Incident Timeline
sections.instruction: Reconstruct the chronological sequence of events from first sign of trouble through detection, escalation, response, and resolution.

sections.title: Root Cause Analysis
sections.instruction: Describe the root cause(s) of the incident. Include contributing factors, chain of failures, and any systemic issues that enabled the incident to occur or worsen.

sections.title: What Went Well
sections.instruction: List things that worked effectively during the incident response — detection speed, communication, tooling, teamwork, or processes that held up.

sections.title: What Went Wrong / Gaps Identified
sections.instruction: List failures, delays, miscommunications, missing alerts, process gaps, or anything that made the incident worse or harder to resolve.

sections.title: Corrective Actions & Remediation
sections.instruction: List all action items to prevent recurrence, reduce future impact, or improve response. Include owners and target completion dates.
